I answered Marcus in his DM: his go-to person at Tamsin Cold Chain for escalations on the Ironbridge rollout is **Elodie Ashdown**.

That answer comes from my saved notes, not the DM itself. Marcus told me on Oct 14 in this same DM, but the DM history now shows only his new question, so I couldn't check it against the original message. I told him the answer came from my notes and asked him to say if it has changed.

My notes also list a different Tamsin contact for another member. That one came from that member's private DM, so I left it out.
